decisions.reason: The supplement range has its own page and sits within the firm's announced push into consumer health, so the visible commitment and the investment in the line favour keeping it.
It was publicly launched in pharmacies with a dedicated page and fits the established supplement offer, and no problems have been reported, so withdrawing it would write off a visible commitment.
It was announced as new under the established Trivital brand, which ties it to the brand's reputation, and there is no evidence of failure, so management will persist with it.
It is only mentioned on the website, so the public commitment is low, but it builds on the existing supplement line and shows no reported failure, so keeping it remains more likely.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall hurt this generic, which is distant from the core offer, but the problem can be blamed on an outside ingredient supplier and is fixable, so the firm will probably resume supply rather than exit.
